rules.title: Ban on common pricing algorithm used in anticompetitive combination (AB 325, B&P Code § 16729(a))
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of the Cartwright Act. A common pricing algorithm is any methodology used by two or more persons that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set, or otherwise influence a price or commercial term.

coverage_conditions.summary: General antitrust rule covering any person (not the end consumer) who uses or distributes a common pricing algorithm, including software used to set rents. It is not limited to housing.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Applies to any 'person' as defined in Section 16702, excluding the end consumer. The algorithm must be used by two or more persons and use competitor data.

rules.interaction: Does not impair or limit the applicability of other antitrust laws (Cartwright Act provisions).
rules.quoted_span: It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of this chapter.

rules.title: Ban on coercing adoption of common pricing algorithm recommendations (AB 325, B&P Code § 16729(b))
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt the price or commercial term the algorithm recommends for the same or similar products or services in California.

coverage_conditions.summary: General rule covering any person who uses or distributes a common pricing algorithm and coerces others to adopt its recommended prices or commercial terms. It is not limited to housing, but can reach rental pricing software.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Requires coercion of another person to adopt the recommended price or commercial term.

rules.interaction: Does not impair or limit the applicability of other antitrust laws.
rules.quoted_span: It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in the jurisdiction of this state.
